descriptions.job-1mgdl2i:
Stronghold's mission is to provide fast, secure, and accessible financial services for all. Through our developer APIs, we enable pay-by-bank embedded payments and financial services while pushing the boundaries of financial innovation. Our SHx token is a key component of our ecosystem, supporting merchant rewards, DeFi-based financing, and governance.

We're a fast-moving, data-driven team committed to compliance, scalability, and innovation. We value curiosity, autonomy, and creative problem solving and we're looking for someone excited to bring a marketing edge.

The role

You'll build toward owning the SHx Markets vertical: expanding SHx market infrastructure and liquidity to strengthen the utility and health of the SHx ecosystem. That means managing and growing relationships across crypto-native and traditional institutional participants (market makers, brokers, exchanges, OTC desks, custodians, and prime brokers) and working closely with the SHx Markets team on strategy and execution. You'll bring a deep understanding of market structure, clearing, settlement, prime brokerage, and custody, and apply it to a market that's still being built.

How ownership works here: you take on our external market maker relationships from the start. The rest of the markets portfolio (exchange relationships, institutional partnerships) transfers to you as you deliver, not by title on day one. We're explicit about this because it's how we work: results earn scope.

This is an entrepreneurial seat on a distributed team, not a chair at an established desk. We're looking for someone who is both strategic and execution-oriented, with the network and reputation to open doors and the judgement to know which ones matter.

What you'll do

  • Manage relationships with market makers, brokers, exchanges, liquidators, and institutional market participants globally.

  • Own key traditional-market relationships: OTC trading desks, quantitative market makers, custodians, and prime brokers.

  • Guide company strategy for enterprise-grade infrastructure and solutions that attract and broaden the SHx markets ecosystem.

  • Explore new ways to partner with existing market participants to accelerate SHx liquidity growth.

  • Help develop crypto and traditional market infrastructure for SHx (listings, market-making programs, settlement).

  • Bring product ideas that expand the utility of the SHx token, and work with product to take the best ones to market.

  • Partner with product, engineering, business development, and leadership to construct the market buildout strategy.

  • Collaborate with compliance, legal, and finance to ensure efficient and compliant execution.

What you'll own

In the first 6 to 12 months, you are the person who:

  • Owns our external market maker relationships.

  • Has earned a growing share of the wider portfolio (exchange listings, OTC desks, custodians, prime brokers) on results.

  • Has taken at least one exchange listing or market making partnership from first conversation to live.

The technical side of the market (data, reconciliation, on-chain infrastructure) stays with our technical team. You own the business of the market.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of markets experience, with a focus on FX or commodities.

  • 5+ years of management experience.

  • 5+ years of business development and/or strategic partnership building.

  • An experienced negotiator who is energized by partnerships and deal-making.

  • Deep understanding of market structure and the liquidity landscape; familiarity with the crypto liquidity ecosystem.

  • Both strategic and execution-oriented; works cross-functionally with internal stakeholders.

  • Outstanding verbal and written communication; serious attention to detail.

  • Conviction about where market infrastructure is headed, and why SHx belongs there.

How we hire

Four conversations: our recruiter, then each founder one on one (our CTO on market structure and liquidity, our CEO on strategy and how you'd build the vertical), then a final round with both.

Location and logistics

San Francisco (hybrid; in office Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday). US work authorization required; no visa sponsorship. Reports to the CEO. Full-time, senior leadership.

Perks & benefits

Health benefits, a seat shaping crypto market infrastructure from the ground up, and a team that values speed, curiosity, and autonomy.

As an equal opportunity employer, Stronghold does not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Authorized to work in the United States (required)

No visa sponsorship available at this time
descriptions.job-019m5re:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

As the Product Manager in Compliance Product, you will own and enhance OKX's compliance systems, with a primary focus on building trust and enhancing user experience. You will lead the development of our institutional onboarding experience — the critical first step in the journey for our business and enterprise customers. This is a highly impactful role where you'll design and optimize onboarding workflows that are secure, scalable, and tailored to the unique needs of institutions.You'll work across cross-functional teams to balance user experience, operational scalability, and regulatory readiness, ensuring that our institutional clients can onboard smoothly and confidently. The ideal candidate should possess strong Product Management skills, excellent problem-solving abilities and good user empathy. If you are an entrepreneurial product leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about driving innovation in compliance, this role will be a great fit for you.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Own end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for institutional clients, including document collection, entity verification and ultimately account activation.
  • Identify friction points across the customer journey that stem from regulatory or risk controls, and reimagine those experiences to be more user-friendly while preserving integrity.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, operations and business teams to understand policy and compliance requirements and translate them into scalable product solutions.
  • Use data, research, and experimentation to make informed product decisions and prioritize improvements.
  • Simplify complex processes through thoughtful product design and automation
  • Drive alignment across multiple stakeholders, balancing user experience, business needs, and regulatory obligations.
  • Design and deliver product solutions that are audit-ready, transparent, and adaptable to evolving regulatory standards.

What We Look For In You:

  • 5+ years of product management experience,ideally with exposure to B2B, fintech, or enterprise platforms.
  • Experience building onboarding, identity verification, or enterprise account experiences.
  • Strong product intuition with a user-first mindset; you’ve designed seamless experiences in complex ecosystems.
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset, with the ability to identify user friction points
  • Experience working with or around regulatory/risk requirements, even if not directly responsible for compliance.
  • Strong systems thinker who can navigate and simplify complex workflows, particularly where multiple stakeholders or roles are involved.
  • Proven ability to work across technical, compliance, business and operational teams to deliver compliant, scalable product solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in translating regulatory or operational needs into product requirements.

Nice to Haves:

  • Familiarity with institutional KYC/KYB processes, AML requirements, or enterprise identity management.
  • Experience with workflow automation, case management systems, or back-office tooling.
  • Background in financial services, SaaS platforms, or B2B marketplaces.
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Competitive total compensation
  • Comprehensive insurance coverage for employees and their dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
